mode: READ-ONLY READINESS AUDIT; not implementation qualification
severityMeaning: Product capability/UX/operability/documentation priority; not vulnerability severity. Deferred wishes are not defects.
securityCoverage: Scoped architecture/source review only; no full security scan or seal
rankingScale: 1..5; higher favors selection; correctness/safety ranks actual current impact, not hypothetical future exploit severity. Final rank includes scope/dependency judgment.
selectionReason: No confirmed high-safety prerequisite overrides G01. G02 is minimal supporting UX. G03 ledger behavior is intentional protection, and G10 is unsupported corrupt-state recovery rather than an observed defect.

gaps.title: Standalone history portability
gaps.currentBehavior: History-only projects are saved/resumable, but full-workspace export rejects a missing root before reading history.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Export validated retained history independently and import it as a new history-only project.

impacts.user: Users cannot transfer valid results after workspace-only deletion without a source/graph root.
impacts.dataIntegrity: Existing retained results remain intact; absent export is not corruption.
impacts.securityAuthority: New file admission must never create authority.
impacts.persistence: Makes history independently portable without changing retention.
impacts.concurrency: Atomic new-project publication, duplicate marker and selection CAS needed.
impacts.backwardCompatibility: Keep full workspace v1/v2/v3 and DB/history schemas unchanged.

gaps.blocksLaterWork: Foundational for portable history workflows, not prerequisite to existing qualified behavior.
gaps.proposedClosure: 8C primary: separate bounded codec and atomic new-project import.

gaps.title: History lifecycle visibility/disclosure
gaps.currentBehavior: Inspector computes historyCount/historyError; Resume categories omit history and workspace deletion text does not say history survives.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Show bounded current history count/error, rootless availability and explicit history-retention disclosure.

impacts.user: History-only state is harder to understand.
impacts.securityAuthority: Truthful status reduces mistaken deletion assumptions.
impacts.concurrency: Refresh must be generation guarded; no revision adoption.
impacts.backwardCompatibility: Append UI category; keep source/graph ordering and delete semantics.

gaps.blocksLaterWork: Supports G01; broader lifecycle management deferred.
gaps.proposedClosure: 8C supporting UX only; no new deletion modes.

gaps.title: Retention occupancy and management
gaps.currentBehavior: Static limit note explains 24/2MiB/512, but no ledger occupancy/eviction forecast or management beyond delete/clear.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Explain capacity and export before future retention decisions; richer occupancy management later.

impacts.user: Surprise at retained-result eviction or lifetime admission limit.
impacts.dataIntegrity: Intentional bounded eviction; private replay ledger correctly survives.
impacts.securityAuthority: Never reset replay ledger to free capacity.
impacts.concurrency: Any future retention change needs shared CAS.

gaps.blocksLaterWork: No blocker to G01; prerequisite policy for pinning.
gaps.proposedClosure: Defer occupancy/retention controls; disclose unchanged limits in 8C.

gaps.title: History pinning/favorites
gaps.currentBehavior: No pin field; retention evicts oldest completion/UUID.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Bounded pins with an explicit eviction and replay policy, if later authorized.

impacts.user: Cannot keep preferred result in retained list.
impacts.dataIntegrity: Unbounded pinning could block retention; not a current defect.
impacts.concurrency: Pin CAS and stale delete policy required.

gaps.title: Editable notes/labels
gaps.currentBehavior: Algorithm labels are strict schema-derived names, not user notes.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Separate bounded editable metadata, without rewriting sealed results.

impacts.dataIntegrity: Notes must not corrupt result digests.
impacts.securityAuthority: Untrusted text must not become instructions/approvals.
impacts.portability: Wire treatment would need separate contract.

gaps.title: Richer inspection/filter/search
gaps.currentBehavior: Bounded 24-entry list plus raw JSON details; backend/input/origin are already presented.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Usability improvements with explicit semantics and bounded filtering.

impacts.user: Long outcomes less convenient to inspect.
impacts.persistence: No storage required for transient filter.
impacts.portability: No prerequisite for independent file transfer.
impacts.backwardCompatibility: Keep labels and raw provenance truthful.

gaps.title: Deterministic rerun comparison/link
gaps.currentBehavior: Rerun enters fresh safe request with new UUID but no record-to-record comparison; k-core usage.elapsedMs is retained in result payload.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Define semantic comparison projections and link separately authorized reruns.

impacts.dataIntegrity: Raw result SHA equality is not universal semantic equality.
impacts.securityAuthority: Comparison must not adopt previous execution authority.
impacts.persistence: Possible new comparison metadata only after policy.
impacts.portability: Imported unverified claims need clear labels.
impacts.concurrency: Current result/rerun races must remain generation bound.
impacts.backwardCompatibility: No retrospective rewrite of historical payload.

gaps.blocksLaterWork: Comparator contract before comparison, not before G01.

gaps.title: Cross-revision result comparison
gaps.currentBehavior: Changed input disables historical rerun; no cross-revision comparison contract.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Explicit comparability of vertices, graph changes, parameters and backend outputs.

impacts.user: Cannot compare changed graph revisions in dedicated UI.
impacts.dataIntegrity: Must not imply graph identity from matching labels.
impacts.securityAuthority: Historical revision claims cannot authorize replacement.
impacts.persistence: Needs bounded relation metadata if persisted.
impacts.concurrency: Current vs historical context race important.

gaps.title: Additional analysis families in history
gaps.currentBehavior: Six CPU families plus validated STATIC/INCREMENTAL motif outcomes; automatic recomputation/stats not explicit archival intent. Ordinary native SSSP lacks current authoritative ordinary graph path in UI.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Only add families with exact bounded result contracts and safe current execution path.

impacts.dataIntegrity: No result loss promised for unsupported family.
impacts.securityAuthority: No implicit projection/CPU fallback/native authority restoration.
impacts.persistence: New schema/contract admission would need design.

gaps.title: Corrupt-history salvage workflow
gaps.currentBehavior: Whole-envelope verification fails closed; cached coordinator initialization and validated mutation reads do not offer record salvage.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Separately reviewed recovery preserving original corrupt bytes and avoiding unverified admission.

impacts.user: Corrupt history is unavailable; no corruption observed in this audit.
impacts.dataIntegrity: Preservation is correct; salvage could discard evidence if unsafe.
impacts.securityAuthority: Fail-closed behavior must not be bypassed by exporter.
impacts.portability: 8C exports only valid history; no forensic export.

gaps.blocksLaterWork: Not prerequisite for valid-history G01; revisit if actual corruption found.
gaps.proposedClosure: Deferred; show truthful category error only.

gaps.title: Startup/native documentation discrepancies
gaps.currentBehavior: README generic incremental path and removal claim differ from consumer; launcher says export/import deferred beyond 7A although 8A/B supports files.
gaps.desiredBehavior: Correct operational descriptions in a separate documentation maintenance boundary.

impacts.user: Operator expectations can differ from runtime.
impacts.securityAuthority: Mode declarations do not prove ACLs; no new vulnerability established.
impacts.persistence: Stable runtime root reconciliation differs from deletion.
impacts.backwardCompatibility: Historical evidence never rewritten to correct prose.

gaps.blocksLaterWork: Not a blocker to G01; independent maintenance.
gaps.proposedClosure: Deferred outside expected 13 paths; preserve both sides in threat model.
